ἐξέρχομαι.kj: come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad
ἐξέρχομαι.as:
ἐξ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly and very freq. for יצא, also for עלה ,בֹּוא, etc. ;] depon.,
to go, or come out of: Mt 10:11, Mk 1:35, Jo 13:30, al.; c. inf., Mt 11:8, Mk 3:21, Lk 7:25, 26Ac 20:8; id. seq. ἐπί, Mt 26:55, al.; εἰς, Mk 1:38; ἵνα, Re 6:2; ἐ. seq. ἐκ (cl. c. gen. loc.), Mk 5:2, Jo 4:30, al.; ἔξω, c. gen., Mt 21:17, Mk 14:68, Ac 16:13, He 13:13; ἀπό, Mk 11:12, Lk 9:5, Phl 4:15; ἐκεῖθεν, Mt 15:21, Mk 6:1, Lk 9:4, al.; of demons expelled, seq. ἐκ (ἀπό), c. gen. pers., Mk 1:25, 265:8, Lk 4:35, al.; of prisoners released, Mt 5:26, Ac 16:40; ptcp., ἐξελθών, c. indic., of verb of departure (cf. Dalman, Words, 20 f.), Mt 8:3215:2124:1, Mk 16:8, Lk 22:39, Ac 12:9, 17 al. Metaph.,
(a) of persons: II Co 6:17, I Jo 2:19; of birth or origin, Mt 2:6(LXX), He 7:5 (cf . Ge 35:11); of escape from danger, ἐκ τ. χειρὸς αὐτῶν, Jo 10:39; of public appearance, I Jo 4:1;
(b) of things: Mt 24:27; esp. of utterances, reports, proclamations: φωνή, Re 16:1719:5; φήμη, Mt 9:26, Lk 4:14; ἀκοή, Mk 1:28; λόγος, Jo 21:23; δόγμα, Lk 2:1 (cf. δι-εξέρχομαι).

ἐξετάζω.long: I examine, question, inquire at, search out.
ἐξετάζω.sd: to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate
ἐξετάζω.as:
ἐξ-ετάζω
(< ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: De 13:14-15De 19:18, I Ch 28:9 A (דּרשׁ), Ps 10 (11) 5, 6 (בּחן), Wi 6:3, Si 3:21, al. ;]
to examine closely, inquire carefully (of): seq. περί (c. ἀκριβῶς), Mt 2:8; seq. τίς, Mt 10:11; c. acc pers., Jo 21:12.†
SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (v. DCG, ii, 594b)

ἐξομολογέω.long: (a) I consent fully, agree out and out, (b) I confess, admit, acknowledge (cf. the early Hellenistic sense of the middle: I acknowledge a debt), (c) I give thanks, praise.
ἐξομολογέω.sd: to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully
ἐξομολογέω.as:
† ἐξ-ομολογέω, -ῶ and depon. mid., -έομαι, -οῦμαι
[as always in LXX chiefly for יָדָה hi. ;]
1. act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, to profess or agree to do (Field, Notes, 75): Lk 22:6.
2. Mid., to acknowledge, confess (MM, Exp., xiv): τ. ἁμαρτίας, Mt 3:6, Mk 1:5, Ja 5:16; τ. πράξεις, Ac 19:18; seq. ὅτι, Phl 2:11; c. dat. pers., to make acknowledgment to one's honour, to praise, give praise to (as in LXX; Kennedy, Sources, 118): Ro 14:11(LXX)15:9(LXX); seq. ὅτι, Mt 11:25, Lk 10:21 (Cremer, 771).†

ἔξω.sd: out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively
ἔξω.as:
ἔξω
adv.
(< ἐξ), [in LXX for חוּץ ;]
1.outside, without;
(a) adverbially: Mt 12:46, Mk 3:3111:4, Lk 8:20, Jo 18:16, al.; c. art., ὁ ἔ., he who is without; metaph., in pl., οἱ ἔ., of those outside the Church, I Co 5:12, 13, Col 4:5 (Lft., in l), I Th 4:12; ὁ ἔ. ἄνθρωπος, II Co 4:16; αἱ ἔ. πόλεις, Ac 26:11;
(b) as prep. c. gen.: Lk 13:33, Ac 21:5, He 13:11, 12
2. After verbs of motion;
(a) adverbially, forth, out: Mt 5:13Mk 14:68, Lk 22:62, Jo 6:3719:4, 13, Ac 9:40, al.;
(b) as prep. c. gen., out of: Mt 21:17, Mk 11:1912:8, Lk 4:29, Ac 7:58, He 13:13, al

ἐξαιρέω.long: I take out, remove; sometimes (mid): I choose, sometimes: I rescue.
ἐξαιρέω.sd: actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release
ἐξαιρέω.as:
ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;]
to take out: c. acc, ὀφθαλμόν, Mt 5:2918:9; mid.
(a)to take out for oneself, choose: Ac 26:17 (Thayer, s.v.; Page, Ac., l.c., but v. infr.);
(b)to deliver: Ac 7:10, 34(LXX)12:1123:2726:17 (EV, but v. supr.), Ga 1:4.†

ἐξουσία.long: (a) power, authority, weight, especially: moral authority, influence, (b) in a quasi-personal sense, derived from later Judaism, of a spiritual power, and hence of an earthly power.
ἐξουσία.sd: privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence
ἐξουσία.kj: authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength
ἐξουσία.der: from G1832 (ἔξεστι) (in the sense of ability);
ἐξουσία.as:
ἐξουσία, -ας, ἡ
(< ἔξεστι), [in LXX: IV Ki 20:13, Ps 113 (114):2135 (136)8, 9, Is 39:2, Je 28 (51):28 (מֶמְשָׁלָה), freq. in Da for Aram. שָׁלְטָן, etc., Wi 10:14, Si 9:13, al. ;]
1. prop., liberty or power to act, freedom to exercise the inward force or faculty expressed by δύναμις (q.v.): I Co 9:12; ἐ. ἔχειν, II Th 3:9; id. seq. inf., Jo 10:18, I Co 9:4, 5; c. gen. obj., Ro 9:21; seq. ἐπί, c. acc., Re 22:14; περί, I Co 7:37.
2. Later (cf. Milligan, Th., 114; MM, Exp., xiv), of the power of right, authority: Mt 21:33, Mk 11:28, Lk 20:2; of Messianic authority, Mt 9:6, Mk 2:10, al.; of apostolic authority, II Co 10:813:10; of the authority of government: Mt 8:928:18, Ju 25, Re 12:10, al.; esp. of judicial authority, Lk 20:20, Jo 19:10, 11.
3. Meton.,
(a)jurisdiction: Lk 23:7 (cf. I Mac 6:11, Is 39:2);
(b)a ruler or magistrate: Ro 13:1-3; pl., Lk 12:11, Ro 13:1, Tit 3:1;
(c) of supramundane powers (syn. with ἀρχή, δύναμις, θρόνος, κυριότης): I Co 15:24, Eph 1:213:10, Col 2:10, I Pe 3:22, al. (Cremer. 236).
SYN.: v.s. δύναμις.

ἐξώτερος.as:
† ἐξώτερος, -α, -ον
(compar., from ἔξω; opp. to ἐσώτερος) [in LXX chiefly for חִיצוֹן ;]
outer: σκότος, Mt 8:1222:1325:30.†

ἔξεστι(ν).sd: so also neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of G1510 (εἰμί) expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public)
ἔξεστι(ν).der: third person singular present indicative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and G1510 (εἰμί);
ἔξεστι(ν).as:
ἔξ-εστι
(< εἰμί),
impers. verb.,
it is permitted, lawful: Mk 2:24, Ac 8:37 (R, mg.), I Co 10:23; c. inf., Mt 12:2, 10, 1214:415:2619:322:1727:6, Mk 3:412:14, Lk 6:2, 914:3, Jo 5:10; seq. acc., Mk 2:26, Lk 6:420:22; c. dat. pers. et inf., Mt 20:15, Mk 6:1810:2, Jo 18:31, Ac 16:2121:3722:25 (inf. understood), I Co 6:12; ἐξόν (sc. ἐστί), Ac 2:29, II Co 12:4; ἐξὸν ἦν, Mt 12:4.†

ἐξίστημι.long: (lit: I remove from a standing position), (a) in trans. tenses: I astonish, amaze, (b) in intrans. tenses: I am astonished, amazed; I am out of my mind, am mad.
ἐξίστημι.sd: to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane
ἐξίστημι.kj: amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder
ἐξίστημι.as:
† ἐξ-ίστημι (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, Ac 8:9),
[in LXX forחרד , etc. (29 words in all) ;],
1. causal in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaph., ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: c. acc pers., Lk 24:22, Ac 8:9, 11.
2.Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., seq. ἐκ or c. gen., to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν,to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.;
(a)to be beside oneself, be mad: Mk 3:21, II Co 5:13 (opp. to σωφρονεῖν);
(b)to be amazed, confounded: Mt 12:23, Mk 2:125:426:51, Lk 2:478:56, Ac 2:7, 128:139:2110:4512:16 (Cremer, 309).†

ἐξανατέλλω.long: I rise (spring) up out (of the ground).
ἐξανατέλλω.sd: to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate
ἐξανατέλλω.as:
ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω
[in LXX: Ge 2:9, Ps 103(104):14Ps 131(132):17Ps 146(147):8 (צָמַח hi.); Ps 111(112):4 (זָרַח) * ;]
1. trans., to cause to spring up(LXX).
2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, Ge 3:18), to spring up: Mt 13:5, Mk 4:5.†

ἑξήκοντα.as:
ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
sixty: Mt 13:8, 23, Mk 4:8, 20, Lk 24:13, I Ti 5:9, Re 11:312:613:18.†

ἕξ.as:
ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
six: Mt 17:1, Lk 13:14, al.

ἔξωθεν.long: (a) from outside, from without, (b) outside, both as adj. and prep; with article: the outside.
ἔξωθεν.as:
ἔξωθεν
adv.
(< ἔξω opp. to ἔσωθεν), [in LXX for חוּץ ;]
1. prop. (in answer to the question, Whence ?), from without: Mk 7:18
2. More often (= ἔξω; cf. Bl., § 25, 3), without: Mt 23:27, 28Mk 7:18, II Co 7:5; τὸ ἔ., Mt 23:25, Lk 11:39, 40; οἱ ἔ., I Ti 3:7, Mk 4:11 (WH, mg.); ὁ ἔ. κόσμος, I Pe 3:3; ἐκβάλλειν ἔ., Re 11:2. As prep. c. gen.: Mk 7:15, Re 11:214:20 (cf. Robertson, Gr., 548).†

ἐξορκίζω.long: I adjure, put to oath; I exorcise.
ἐξορκίζω.sd: to exact an oath, i.e. conjure
ἐξορκίζω.as:
ἐξ-ορκίζω
(later form of ἐξορκόω ), [in LXX: Jg 17:2 (אָלָה), Ge 24:3, III Ki 22:16 (שָׁבַע hi.)* ;]
1.to administer an oath to (Dem., Polyb., al.).
2.to adjure: c. acc pers., seq. κατά, c. gen. (as freq. in magic π.; MM, Exp., xiv), Mt 26:63.†

ἐξορύσσω.long: (a) I dig out, hence: I open up, (b) I gouge.
ἐξορύσσω.sd: to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing)
ἐξορύσσω.as:
ἐξ-ορύσσω
[in LXX: Pr 29:22; ὀφθαλμόν (-ούς), Jg 16:21, I Ki 11:2 (נָקַר)* ;]
to dig out, dig up: στέγην, Mk 2:4; metaph., ὀφθαλμούς (cf. LXX, ll c.; Herod., viii, 116), Ga 4:15.†

ἐξαυτῆς.kj: by and by, immediately, presently, straightway
ἐξαυτῆς.der: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the genitive case singular feminine of G846 (αὐτός) (G5610 (ὥρα) being understood);
ἐξαυτῆς.as:
* ἐξ-αυτῆς
(a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας)
at once, forthwith: Mk 6:25, Ac 10:3311:1121:3223:30, Phl 2:23.†

ἐξάπινα.der: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of the same as G160 (αἰφνίδιος);
ἐξάπινα.as:
† ἐξάπινα = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (q.v.),
[in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;]
suddenly: Mk 9:8.†

ἐξουδενέω.long: I set at naught, ignore, despise.
ἐξουδενέω.sd: to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise
ἐξουδενέω.der: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of the neuter of G3762 (οὐδείς);
ἐξουδενέω.as:
† ἐξ-ουδενέω
(Rec. -όω; T, -θενόω), -ῶ, [in LXX (with vv. ll. -όω, -θενέω, -θενόω) for בּוּז, בָּזָה, מָאַס, בּוּס, etc. ;]
to despise, set at nought: Mk 9:12 (cf. ἐξουθενέω).†

ἐξανίστημι.long: (a) in trans. tenses: I raise up, cause to grow, (b) in intrans. tenses: I rise up from.
ἐξανίστημι.sd: objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object
ἐξανίστημι.as:
ἐξ-ανίστημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. Ge 38:8), Mk 12:19, Lk 20:28.
2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: Ac 15:5.†

ἐξαίφνης.der: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G160 (αἰφνίδιος);
ἐξαίφνης.as:
ἐξ-αίφνης (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. Ac 22:6; v. App., p. 151, and cf. M, Pr., 35), adv.
(< ἄφνω), [in LXX chiefly for פִתְאׄם ;]
suddenlyMk 13:36, Lk 2:139:39, Ac 9:322:6.†

ἐξάγω.long: I lead out, sometimes to death, execution.
ἐξάγω.as:
ἐξ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;]
to lead out: c. acc, Mk 15:20, Jo 10:3, Ac 5:197:3616:37, 39; seq. ἔξω, Lk 24:50; ἐκ, Ac 7:4012:1713:17, He 8:9; εἰς, Ac 21:38.†

ἐξαγγέλλω.der: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);
ἐξαγγέλλω.as:
ἐξ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to tell out, proclaim: I Pe 2:9 [Mk 16:1-20, "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).†

ἐξαποστέλλω.long: I send away, send forth (a person qualified for a task).
ἐξαποστέλλω.sd: to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss
ἐξαποστέλλω.as:
ἐξ-απο-στέλλω
[in LXX freq., chiefly for שָׁלַח pi. ;]
1.to send forth: c. acc pers., Ac 7:1212:11, Ga 4:4; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, Lk 24:49; τ. πνεῦμα, Ga 4:6; [τ. κήρυγμα, Mk 16:1-20, "shorter conclusion," WH ;] seq. εἰς, Ac 22:21; pass., ὁ λόγος, Ac 13:26.
2.to send away: c. acc pers., seq. εἰς, Ac 9:30; seq. ἕως, Ac 11:22; c. inf., Ac 17:14; κενόν, Lk 1:5320:10, 11.†

ἑξῆς.g: next in order, the next day
ἑξῆς.long: next in order, the next day, the following day, at the period immediately following.
ἑξῆς.der: from G2192 (ἔχω) (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining);
ἑξῆς.as:
ἑξῆς
adv.
(< ἔχω),
in order, successively, next: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, Lk 9:37; ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, Lk 7:11; τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Ac 21:125:1727:18.†

ἐξαστράπτω.long: I flash forth like lightning, gleam, am radiant.
ἐξαστράπτω.sd: to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments)
ἐξαστράπτω.as:
† ἐξ-αστράπτω
[in LXX: Nu 3:3 (בָּרָק), Ez 1:4 (לָקַח hithp.) 1:7 Da LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;]
to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, Lk 9:29.†

ἔξοδος.long: (a) an exit, going out, departure from a place; the exodus, (b) death.
ἔξοδος.as:
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(< ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;]
a going out, departure: He 11:22; of death, Lk 9:31, II Pe 1:15.†

ἐξουθενέω.long: I set at naught, ignore, despise.
ἐξουθενέω.kj: contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought
ἐξουθενέω.der: a variation of G1847 (ἐξουδενόω) and meaning the same
ἐξουθενέω.as:
† ἐξ-ουθενέω, -ῶ
(< οὐθείς, q.v.), [in LXX (v.s. ἐξουθενέω): I Ki 2:30, al., and as v.l. for -δενέω, -όω, -θενόω* ;]
to set at nought, despise utterly, treat with contempt: c. acc pers., Lk 18:923:11, Ro 14:3, 10, I Co 16:11; c. acc rei, Ga 4:14, I Th 5:20; pass., of persons: Mk 9:12 (T, -όω), I Co 6:4; of things λίθος, Ac 4:11 (LXX ἀπεδοκίμασαν); λόγος, II Co 10:10; τὰ ἐξουθενημένα, I Co 1:28.†
SYN.: ἀθετέω, καταφρονέω (v. DCG, i, 453b)

ἐξουσιάζω.long: I exercise (wield) power (authority), pass: I am ruled, am held under authority.
ἐξουσιάζω.kj: exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of
ἐξουσιάζω.as:
ἐξουσιάζω
(< ἐξουσία) [in LXX (freq. in Ec) chiefly for שָׁלַט ;]
1.to exercise authority (Arist.).
2. Trans., to exercise authority over: c. gen. pers., Lk 22:25; c. gen. rei, I Co 7:4; pass., to be held under authority (v. Lft., Notes, 214): seq. ὑπό, I Co 6:12.†

ἐξαιτέομαι.long: I demand of, ask for, beg earnestly for.
ἐξαιτέομαι.der: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G154 (αἰτέω);
ἐξαιτέομαι.as:
* ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ
to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, c. acc (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), Lk 22:31 (v. Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).†

ἐξηγέομαι.long: I lead, show the way; met: I unfold, narrate, declare.
ἐξηγέομαι.sd: to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold
ἐξηγέομαι.as:
ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to lead, show the way; metaph., to unfold, narrate, declare: c. acc rei, Lk 24:35Ac 21:19; c. dat. pers., Ac 10:8; θεόν (understood), Jo 1:18; seq. ὅσα, Ac 15:12; καθώς, Ac 15:14.†

ἐξυπνίζω.as:
ἐξ-υπνίζω
[in LXX: Jg 16:14, 20, III Ki 3:13 (יָקַץ), Jb 14:12 (עוּר ni.)* ;]
to awaken out of sleep (= ἀφυπνίζω): c. acc pers., Jo 11:11.†

ἐξάλλομαι.as:
ἐξ-άλλομαι
[in LXX for קָלַל (Hb 1:8), etc. ;]
to leap up: Ac 3:8.†

ἐξαλείφω.long: I plaster, wash over; I wipe off, wipe out, obliterate.
ἐξαλείφω.sd: to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin)
ἐξαλείφω.as:
ἐξ-αλείφω
[in LXX for טוּחַ, Le 14:42, al.; metaph., מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;]
1.to plaster, wash over(LXX).
2.to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, Re 7:1721:4; metaph., χειρόγραφον, Col 2:14; τ. ὄνομα, seq. ἐκ, Re 3:5 (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), Ac 3:19 (cf. Ps 50(15):11Ps 108(109):13, Is 43:25, Si 46:20 (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), III Mac 2:19).†

ἐξολεθρεύω.long: I destroy utterly, annihilate, exterminate, root out.
ἐξολεθρεύω.as:
† ἐξ-ολεθρεύω
(so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX freq. (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;]
to destroy utterly: seq. ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, Ac 3:23(LXX).†

ἐξωθέω.long: I drive out, expel, propel, thrust out; I drive out of the sea, drive on shore.
ἐξωθέω.sd: to expel; by implication, to propel
ἐξωθέω.as:
ἐξ-ωθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָדָה hi. ;]
1.to thrust out: Ac 7:45.
2.to drive out of the sea, drive on shore: Ac 27:39 (WH, txt., ἐκσῶσαι).†

ἔξειμι.long: (originally: I shall go out), I go out (away), depart.
ἔξειμι.sd: to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore)
ἔξειμι.as:
ἔξ-ειμι
(< εἶμι),
to go forth: Ac 13:4217:1520:7; seq. ἐπί, c. acc, Ac 27:43.†

ἔξυπνος.as:
**† ἔξ-υπνος, -ον
(< ὕπνος), [in LXX: I Es 3:3 * ;]
roused out of sleep: Ac 16:27.†

ἐξορκιστής.long: an exorcist, a caster out of evil spirits by the use of names or spells.
ἐξορκιστής.sd: one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer)
ἐξορκιστής.as:
*† ἐξ-ορκιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(< ἐξορκίζω),
1.one who administers an oath.
2.an exorcist: Ac 19:13.†

ἐξαρτίζω.long: (a) I fit up, completely furnish, equip, furnish, supply, (b) I accomplish, finish.
ἐξαρτίζω.sd: to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher)
ἐξαρτίζω.der: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G739 (ἄρτιος);
ἐξαρτίζω.as:
† ἐξ-αρτίζω
(< ἄρτιος), [in LXX. Ex 28:7 (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
1.to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, Ac 21:5.
2.to furnish, supply: pass., II Ti 3:17 (for exx., v. MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).†

ἐξοχή.der: from a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and G2192 (ἔχω) (meaning to stand out);
ἐξοχή.as:
ἐξοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< ἐξέχω, to stand out), [in LXX for שֵׁן, Jb 39:28 * ;]
1.a projection (ἐ. πέτρας, Jb 39:28).
2. Metaph., eminence, excellence: οἱ κατ’ ἐ., the chief men, Ac 25:23.†

ἐξαπατάω.as:
ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω,
[in LXX: Ex 8:29 (הָתַל hi.), Da TH Sus 56* ;]
to deceive: c. acc, Ro 7:11Ro 16:18, I Co 3:18, II Co 11:3, II Th 2:3; pass., I Ti 2:14.†

ἐξεγείρω.sd: to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction)
ἐξεγείρω.as:
ἐξ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;]
to raise up: Ro 9:17 (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, I Co 6:14.†

ἐξαίρω.as:
ἐξ-αίρω
[in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: I Co 5:13(LXX)†

ἐξαπορέομαι.g: I am utterly without resource, am in despair
ἐξαπορέομαι.long: I am utterly without resource, am in despair.
ἐξαπορέομαι.sd: to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond
ἐξαπορέομαι.der: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G639 (ἀπορέω);
ἐξαπορέομαι.as:
† ἐξ-απορέω, -ῶ
[in LXX, pass., for פּוּן, Ps 87(88):15 * ;]
so in NT, depon. pass., to be utterly at a loss, be in despair: absol. (as Ps, l.c.), II Co 4:8; τοῦ ζῆν, II Co 1:8.†

ἐξαγοράζω.long: I buy out, buy away from, ransom; mid: I purchase out, buy, redeem, choose.
ἐξαγοράζω.sd: to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity)
ἐξαγοράζω.as:
† ἐξ-αγοράζω
[in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Da LXX TH 2:8 * ;]
1.to redeem, ransom (esp. of slaves): metaph., Ga 3:134:5.
2.to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, Eph 5:16, Col 4:5 (Cremer, 60).†

ἐξισχύω.g: I have strength for, am perfectly able
ἐξισχύω.long: I have strength for (a difficult task), am perfectly able.
ἐξισχύω.sd: to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent
ἐξισχύω.as:
**† ἐξ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Si 7:6 * ;]
to have strength enough, to be quite able: c. inf., Eph 3:18.†

ἐξανάστασις.long: a rising up and out, resurrection.
ἐξανάστασις.as:
* ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἐξανίστημι),
a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, Phl 3:11 (Cremer, 308).†

ἐξηχέομαι.long: I sound out (forth) (referring either to the clearness or to the loudness of the sound).
ἐξηχέομαι.sd: to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported)
ἐξηχέομαι.der: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G2278 (ἠχέω);
ἐξηχέομαι.as:
† ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jl 3 (4):14 (הָמוֹן), Si 40:13, III Mac 3:2 * ;]
to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; v. M, Th., l.c.): pass., I Th 1:8.†

ἕξις.long: condition, state, habit, use, especially: good condition of body or soul.
ἕξις.as:
† ἕξις, -εως, ἡ
(< ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Si, prol. 9 ;]
habit, use, experience: He 5:14.†

ἐξέλκω.long: (lit: I draw out of the right place, or I draw aside out of the right way), I entice.
ἐξέλκω.sd: to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin)
ἐξέλκω.as:
ἐξ-έλκω
[in LXX: Ge 37:28 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw out or away: metaph., ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, Ja 1:14 (v. Mayor, in l).†

ἐξεραυνάω.long: I search diligently, I examine carefully (minutely).
ἐξεραυνάω.as:
ἐξ-εραυνάω
(Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
to search out, search carefully: seq. περί, I Pe 1:10.†

ἐξακολουθέω.sd: to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to
ἐξακολουθέω.as:
† ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX Am 2:4, Je 2:2 (אַחַרהָלַךְ), Is 56:11 (פָּנָה), Jb 31:9 (פָּתָה ni.), Si 5:2, Da LXX TH 3:(41)* ;]
to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaph., II Pe 1:162:2 ,15 †

ἐξέραμα.der: from a comparative of G1537 (ἐκ) and a presumed (to spue);
ἐξέραμα.as:
*† ἐξέραμα, -τος, τό
(< ἐξεράω, to evacuate, disgorge)
a vomit: II Pe 2:22(LXX).†

ἑξακόσιοι.der: plural ordinal from G1803 (ἕξ) and G1540 (ἑκατόν);
